newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BIL weakens after setting Thistle price.
newsitem.headline: BIL weakens after setting Thistle price.

text.p: Brierley Investments Ltd's share price weakened slightly on Wednesday after the company set a 170 pence share price for the float of Thistle Hotels Plc.
By 9.40 a.m. (2140 GMT) BIL was off two cents at NZ$1.37 on light volume while the broader market was largely static.
Brokers said the weakness arose from the fact that the price for Thistle was right at the bottom of an indicative 170-210 pence range.
"It was at the bottom end of the range, so it's been a bit of a rude shock," Tim Koller at Hendry Hay McIntosh said.
Koller said BIL had been looking soft over the last week, indicating BIL was having trouble setting a suitable price.
"Everybody's expectations came back to under two pounds but I think it was still a surprise for it to come in right at the bottom of the range," he said.
BIL said earlier that after the float, its holding in Thistle would fall to 46 percent from 70 percent.
